title: Breaking the Safety-Capability Tradeoff: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards Maintains Safety Guardrails in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with hate-inducing instructions from the I-CoNa dataset and evaluating the harmfulness of the generated responses using a continuous DeBERTa-based score predictor and a binary HarmBench indicator.

Evaluating model responses to prompts on highly polarizing and ethically sensitive topics, such as immigration (using the I-Controversial dataset), and scoring them with automated harmfulness classifiers.
